comment: Public price card (D-80). Miners pay quantity x rate per line item, in USDC (1 USDC = 1 USD on this card; payments arrive in TAO and are kept as USDC, billing/tao.py). Detector prices are the vendors' list prices; judge prices are OpenRouter list prices at card time; Lium is the hourly price of the GPU pod (H100 80GB HBM3, else H200) incl. setup. Changing any rate means a new version (its sha256 is pinned in every quote and statement).
